scientific_integrity: Exact finite statements are supported by direct counting. Limit distributions are deduced from the multinomial central limit theorem and character diagonalization; finite enumeration corroborates but does not prove the asymptotic result.
scientific_limitations: All results concern rank-one finite-field matrices conditioned on no zero entries, fixed field order, and both matrix dimensions tending to infinity. No quantitative convergence rate or generalization to higher rank is claimed. Related decompositions occur in Sanna (2023), Lemma 5.4; a prior equivalent conditional result cannot be excluded by a bounded literature search.
title: Non-Gaussian entry histograms of full-support rank-one finite-field matrices
